references.title: Albanian Heritage: Beginning of the First Siege of Krujë, based on Albanian Encyclopedic Dictionary 2009 vol. 3 p. 2274
references.scope: Institutional reproduction of Academy encyclopedic entry; garrison under Vrana Konti and Skanderbeg operating outside. Inflated troop/casualty figures and the death-from-grief narrative are not adopted.

references.title: Luan Malltezi, “Venetian” Albania and Scanderbeg, Studia Albanica 2018/2
references.scope: Original historical scholarship using documentary collections. Printed p.87 notes65–66 supports Venetian merchant provisions and Skanderbeg attacks on convoys in 1450.
